items.title: Alvin Alcorn and Eddie Marrero Interview, 1979-12-04
items.q: I was playing with, no, it wasn't Chris Kelly.

ctx.x: Who were you playing with right before you quit?
Who was I playing with? Yeah. When I quit? Uh-huh. I was playing with, no, it wasn't Chris Kelly. Did you tell you about this? No. I was playing with a young tuxedo band.
